test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A, B, R, D, I, S, and T are sitting around a circular table facing away from the circle. A does not sit adjacent to I and T. B does not sit adjacent to A. R sits fourth to the left of A. D and B sit adjacent to each other. S sits third to the left of I. Who is the immediate neighbour of both T and A?
solution:
Given: A, B, R, D, I, S, and T. 

1) R sits fourth to the left of A.

2) B does not sit adjacent to A.

3) D and B sit adjacent to each other. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/911687f6682cf3e3037e4453003022f118e7270cfee140e626a686c0de96f10c.png] 

4) S sits third to the left of I.

5) A does not sit adjacent to I and T. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8695e1b911f928fd71a7e2dc88391928fac634d0b65dc14d2ddcc310ff8983a8.png] 

So, 'S' is the immediate neighbor of both T and A.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
